drona_tasks.label: Number of tasks
drona_tasks.help: This is the number of tasks your code can utilize. This is mainly for codes that use MPI. If you are not sure, just leave this as 1
drona_tasks.name: drona_tasks

drona_nodes.label: Number of nodes (optional)
drona_nodes.help: Only set this field if you requested multiple tasks above and you want to distribute these tasks over multiple nodes. This is most common for MPI codes.
drona_nodes.name: drona_nodes

drona_cpus.label: Number of cpus per tasks
drona_cpus.help: Mostly used for hybrid codes that use multiple threads per task.
drona_cpus.name: drona_cpus

drona_gpuDropdown.label: Use Accelerator
drona_gpuDropdown.help: Only select an accelerator if your job will utilize them. You might need to setup the environment for the accelerator you selected in the job script.
drona_gpuDropdown.name: drona_gpu

drona_numgpus.label: #GPUs
drona_numgpus.help: Number of accelerators you want to use.
drona_numgpus.name: drona_numgpu

drona_memory.label: TOTAL Memory
drona_memory.name: drona_memory
drona_memory.help: OPTIONAL: Provide the total amount of memory you need to estimate the job needs.

drona_Walltime.label: Expected run time
drona_Walltime.help: OPTIONAL: Provide the time you estimate the job will need.
drona_Walltime.name: drona_walltime

drona_account.label: Project Account
drona_account.help: OPTIONAL: Use a different project account than your default.
drona_account.name: drona_account
